ConnectionStrings._comment: Matches docker-compose.yml's local-only Postgres/Azurite containers — not secrets (NFR-402): throwaway local containers protect nothing. Must move to Key Vault + managed identity (docs/03-architecture/06-security-strategy.md §5) before any deployment beyond localhost. The Azurite connection string uses its well-known, publicly-documented default development account/key — not a real credential.
